Position Description

CGI is seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Consultant with expertise in federal financial management to support the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP solutions for federal government clients. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of federal financial processes, particularly Funds Management (FM), budget execution, and funds control within SAP S/4HANA.

In this role, you will work closely with clients to gather requirements, facilitate workshops, design solutions, configure SAP functionality, and support full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementations across federal business process areas.

Location: Fairfax, VA; Lebanon, VA; Lafayette, LA; or Knoxville, TN. Hybrid work is available, with a requirement to work from a CGI Federal office two days per week.

Your future duties and responsibilities

  • Lead requirements gathering sessions and workshops to identify, validate, and document business and system requirements.
  • Analyze business processes, identify gaps, and recommend effective SAP S/4HANA solutions.
  • Design, configure, test, and support SAP S/4HANA solutions, with a focus on Funds Management (FM), Public Sector Management (PSM), and Federal Financials.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and liaison between clients and project teams to resolve issues and ensure successful solution delivery.
  • Create Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and support the development of Technical Design Documents (TDDs) and future-state process designs.
  • Configure and test end-to-end business processes, including cross-functional integrations and SAP Fiori applications.
  • Provide functional expertise, presentations, training, and guidance on SAP products and solutions.
  • Support all phases of SAP S/4HANA implementation projects, including requirements, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams to ensure successful integration across SAP modules.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

  • Due to the nature of the government contract requirements and/or clearance requirements, US citizenship is required as well as successful passing of CGI background check prior to beginning work. In addition, candidates must have ability to obtain and maintain a DHS/CISA EOD/Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 7 years of federal financial management experience, including at least 5 years supporting federal financial system implementations.
  • Experience implementing and supporting SAP S/4HANA solutions in federal government environments.
  • Expertise in federal financial management processes, SAP demonstrations, testing, and best practices.
  • Experience configuring and implementing one or more SAP modules, including: Finance (FI), Funds Management (FM), Sales and Distribution (SD), and Materials Management (MM).
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting SAP S/4HANA Public Sector solutions for federal agencies.
  • Strong understanding of SAP module integration points and cross-functional business processes.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using the SAP Activate methodology.
  • SAP S/4HANA Financials certification.
  • Experience integrating SAP with modules such as SD, MM, Project Systems (PS), FI, FM, and Supplier Relationship Management (SRM).
  • Experience designing interfaces with federal systems such as Go.gov, mLINQS, IPP, G-Invoicing, IPAC, CIR, and U.S. Treasury systems.
  • Experience supporting large-scale federal ERP modernization and transformation initiatives.

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The opportunity

We are seeking an SAP IBP professional to join our Technology Consulting team and contribute to complex supply chain transformation engagements. In this role, you will work closely with clients and cross-functional teams to design and implement SAP-enabled planning solutions that improve business performance. You will gain exposure to end-to-end delivery, strengthen your functional and technical expertise, and grow your ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions.

As a Senior in Technology Business Analysis, you will be instrumental in connecting business needs with technical solutions. You will play a pivotal role in evaluating business models, eliciting requirements, and ensuring the technical teams deliver solutions that are in perfect harmony with business objectives.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Design, configure, test, and deploy SAP IBP Response & Supply and PP/DS (PPDS) solutions, including time-series and order-based planning capabilities.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Configuring and implementing solutions that align with business needs
  • Identifying opportunities for service expansion and contributing to sales through RFP responses
  • Expect to travel regularly and lead project streams while actively engaging with clients.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SAP IBP and PP/DS with S/4HANA, ECC, and legacy APO environments.
  • Provide design insights and lead the build, testing, and deployment of supply chain solutions across various technology landscapes
  • Exhibit hands-on technical capabilities in SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) tool and demonstrated strong business acumen of demand planning or supply planning capabilities. Show a continuous willingness to learn and adapt to new knowledge.
  • Facilitate client workshops, requirements sessions, and design discussions to help drive solution alignment and adoption.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality client services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as change management, and provide relevant inputs as part of larger transformation engagements.
  • Show curiosity and initiative in developing client sector knowledge to help co-create EY industry solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On your typical engagement, you will collaborate with EY workstream leads, assisting them during the exploration and design phases to capture business requirements and propose technology designs. Role: SAP MM/EWM Consultant– ECC

Location: Austin TX

Duration: Fulltime

Work Type: Hybrid ( 3 Days Onsite)


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior SAP MM/EWM Consultant to join our team. The ideal candidate will possess extensive knowledge in SAP Material Management (MM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) within both SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA environments. This role is critical for our ongoing projects, particularly in facilitating the migration from ECC to S/4 HANA. The consultant will be responsible for configuring and optimizing our SAP MM/EWM solutions to meet business needs and enhance operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Lead the configuration and implementation of SAP MM and EWM modules, ensuring alignment with business processes and requirements.

Conduct thorough analysis of existing ECC systems and develop migration strategies to transition to SAP S/4 HANA.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver high-quality SAP configurations.

Provide expert guidance and support during the testing phase, ensuring that all configurations meet business expectations.

Develop and maintain documentation related to system configurations, processes, and user guides.

Train and mentor junior consultants and end-users on SAP MM/EWM functionalities and best practices.

Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and trends to continuously improve system performance and user experience.

Mandatory Skills

Proven expertise in SAP Material Management (MM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).

Strong experience with SAP ECC and SAP S/4 HANA, particularly in migration projects.

In-depth knowledge of SAP configuration and integration processes.

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

Experience with SAP Fiori and other SAP UI technologies.

Knowledge of additional SAP modules such as SD, PP, or WM.

Familiarity with Agile methodologies and project management tools.

Certifications in SAP MM/EWM or related fields.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

10-15 years of relevant experience in SAP MM/EWM consulting.

Proven track record of successful SAP implementations and migrations.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

If you are a dedicated professional with a passion for SAP solutions and a desire to drive business success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.


The pay range for this role is USD $140,000- $145,000 per annum including any bonuses or variable pay. Tech Mahindra also offers benefits like medical, vision, dental, life, disability insurance and paid time off (including holidays, parental leave, and sick leave, as required by law). Ask our recruiters for more details on our Benefits package. The exact offer terms will depend on the skill level, educational qualifications, experience and location of the candidate.


AI tools may assist in the recruitment process; however, all hiring decisions are made by the recruitment team based on a comprehensive evaluation of candidates.


“Tech Mahindra is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We promote and support a diverse workforce at all levels of the company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, or disability. All applicants will be evaluated solely on the basis of their ability, competence, and performance of the essential functions of their positions with or without reasonable accommodations. Reasonable accommodations also are available in the hiring process for applicants with disabilities. Candidates can request a reasonable accommodation by contacting the company ADA Coordinator at ADA_Accomodations@TechMahindra.com.”

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY helps utilities organizations transform their operations through innovative SAP solutions that improve efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and support regulatory compliance. We work with clients across the utility value chain, helping them navigate complex business and technology transformations from strategy through execution.

As an SAP IS-U Customer Service Senior Consultant, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and implementation of customer-facing SAP IS-U solutions. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate utility service-operation requirements into effective functional solutions that support customer, account, contract, premise, service-request, and customer-contact processes across the meter-to-cash lifecycle.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with clients and internal teams to deliver SAP IS-U Customer Service solutions. You will apply your functional knowledge, analytical skills, and utility industry experience to address complex customer-service requirements and support successful project delivery. This position may require regular travel to meet client needs. Key responsibilities include:

  • Gathering and analyzing requirements for customer and account maintenance, service requests, move-in and move-out, transfers, start and stop service, and related customer processes.
  • Supporting the functional design and configuration of SAP IS-U Customer Service solutions, including business partner, contract account, utility contract, premise, service connection, and related customer master data.
  • Designing and supporting service-request, notification, correspondence, and customer-contact processes in alignment with the deployed SAP IS-U and contact-center solutions.
  • Translating service-operation requirements into reliable customer, account, contract, premise, and service-request workflows.
  • Coordinating end-to-end process impacts and dependencies across Billing, FI-CA, Device Management, Work Management, Retail Choice, digital channels, field service, and external contact-center systems.
  • Analyzing customer-impacting exceptions involving service activation, account changes, billing readiness, payment status, field-work requests, customer data, contract data, or system integrations.
  • Designing and documenting business requirements and end-to-end process flows for customer self-service web, mobile, and interactive voice response solutions integrated with SAP IS-U Customer Service and meter-to-cash processes.
  • Preparing functional designs, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process flows, data mappings, and other project deliverables.
  • Executing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect resolution, and production issue analysis.
  • Supporting customer, account, contract, premise, and service-point data conversion activities, including data mapping, validation, reconciliation, and cutover readiness.
  • Supporting cutover, data validation, production incidents, operational procedures, and post-go-live stabilization for customer and contract processes.
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders, business users, technical teams, integration teams, and project leadership to communicate issues, clarify requirements, and support timely solution decisions.
  • Providing knowledge transfer, user procedures, and functional guidance to client teams and junior project team members while clearly documenting customer and data impacts.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To thrive in this role, you will need a combination of SAP IS-U Customer Service knowledge, utility industry experience, and strong client-service skills. Your ability to analyze complex customer-lifecycle requirements, collaborate across functional and technical teams, and communicate clearly will be important to delivering successful outcomes.

  • Strong functional knowledge of SAP IS-U Customer Service and the broader utility meter-to-cash process.
  • Hands-on knowledge of SAP IS-U business partner, contract account, utility contract, premise, service connection, and customer-service concepts.
  • Experience with utility customer-lifecycle processes, including customer and account maintenance, move-in and move-out, transfers, start and stop service, service requests, notifications, and customer contacts.
  • Understanding of customer-service dependencies involving Billing, FI-CA, Device Management, Work Management, field service, digital channels, and contact-center platforms.
  • Ability to translate business, regulatory, operational, and customer-experience requirements into practical SAP IS-U functional designs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate customer-impacting exceptions and identify root causes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business, functional, technical, data, and integration teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain functional requirements and solution decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage assigned deliverables, dependencies, risks, and priorities in a client-service environment.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • Typically, no less than 3 to 4 years of SAP IS-U or SAP Utilities experience, including at least three years of hands-on experience in SAP IS-U Customer Service.
  • Hands-on experience delivering functional requirements, configuration or solution design, testing, and production support in a utility environment.
  • Experience with SAP IS-U customer, business partner, contract account, utility contract, premise, service connection, and customer-service processes.
  • Experience supporting utility customer-lifecycle processes, including account maintenance, service requests, move-in and move-out, transfers, and start and stop service.
  • An understanding of meter-to-cash processes and the dependencies among Customer Service, Billing, FI-CA, Device Management, Work Management, field service, and connected systems.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process flows, data mappings, and other project documentation.
  • Experience executing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect resolution, cutover, and production stabilization.
  • Experience supporting customer and contract data conversion activities, including data mapping, validation, reconciliation, or cutover readiness.
  • Experience working with business users, technical teams, integration teams, and project stakeholders to resolve functional and cross-workstream issues.
  • Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Prior consulting experience.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Utilities.
  • Experience with SAP CRM, SAP Sales and Service Cloud, formerly SAP C4C, or a modern contact-center platform.
  • Experience with regulated or deregulated utility customer-service processes.
  • Experience designing or supporting customer self-service web, mobile, interactive voice response, correspondence, or omnichannel solutions.
  • Experience integrating SAP IS-U Customer Service with digital channels, contact-center platforms, field-service applications, or external customer-experience solutions.
  • Experience supporting high-volume utility customer-service operations or large-scale meter-to-cash transformations.
  • Knowledge of utility regulatory requirements, market operations, and customer-communication requirements.
  • Experience supporting customer and contract data conversion, cutover, operational readiness, reconciliation, or post-go-live production support.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are not only technically proficient but also possess the qualities of a leader. Top performers are proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement. They thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about delivering exceptional results for clients.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Dear Applicant,

We have 5 active SAP FTE openings across different SAP modules. Interested candidates are requested to review the job descriptions below and reply with the position(s) they are suitable for, along with their updated resume, current location, and availability.

Work Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid (work from the client's office); remote work is also an option with travel to the client's office as needed.

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

  • Hiring: SAP FICO Consultant

Job Title: SAP FICO Consultant

Experience: 10 12 Years

Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid; remote option available with travel as needed

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Responsibilities

  • Understand the business requirements of the organization.
  • Configure G/L, A/P, A/R, and Asset Accounting.
  • Demonstrate a good command of costing.
  • Enhance SAP functionality based on end-user requirements.
  • Configure global settings and enterprise structure settings.
  • Prepare blueprints for implementing business processes.
  • Validate reporting requirements and customization changes.
  • Provide training to end users and prepare end-user training documents.
  • Resolve day-to-day end-user queries.
  • Gather information about current business processes and prepare documentation.
  • Perform data mapping between source and target environments.
  • Conduct gap analysis between As-Is and To-Be processes.
  • Perform functional and integration testing.
  • Prepare workflows defining business process sequences to deliver projects within scope, budget, and timelines.
  • Provide production support for other integrated SAP modules.
  • Multitask and manage multiple deliverables and projects simultaneously.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience in SAP FICO.
  • General Ledger (G/L), Accounts Payable (A/P), Accounts Receivable (A/R), and Asset Accounting.
  • Costing, configuration, and enterprise structure settings.
  • Business requirements gathering, blueprinting, data mapping, and gap analysis.
  • Functional testing, integration testing, end-user training, and production support.

2. Hiring: Senior SAP SD Consultant / SAP SD Lead

Job Title: Senior SAP SD Consultant / SAP SD Lead

Experience: 10 12 Years of Relevant SAP SD Experience

Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid; remote option available with travel as needed

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced SAP SD Consultant with 10+ years of strong functional expertise in SAP Sales and Distribution (SD). The candidate should have extensive experience in end-to-end SAP implementations, support, and enhancements, with deep knowledge of Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, pricing, billing, shipping, and customer master management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP SD implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
  • Analyze business requirements and design SAP SD solutions to optimize sales and distribution processes.
  • Configure and support SAP SD functionalities, including:
    • Sales Order Management
    • Pricing and Taxation
    • Billing and Invoicing
    • Shipping and Delivery Processing
    • Credit Management
    • Returns and Refunds
    • Output Determination
    • Customer Master Data Management
  • Work closely with business users to improve Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
  • Integrate SAP SD with SAP MM, FI, PP, WM/EWM, and CRM modules.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA transformation and migration initiatives.
  • Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with ABAP technical teams for custom developments.
  • Conduct unit testing, SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
  • Provide post-go-live support and resolve critical production issues.
  • Mentor junior consultants and provide end-user training and documentation.
Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 10 12 years of hands-on experience in SAP SD functional consulting.
  • Minimum 2 3 full-lifecycle SAP implementation projects.
  • Strong expertise in Order-to-Cash (O2C) business processes.
  • Extensive experience in pricing procedures, billing, shipping, and sales configuration.
  • Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, FI, PP, and WM/EWM modules.
  • Experience in SAP S/4HANA SD functionalities and best practices.
  • Knowledge of IDocs, interfaces, and third-party system integrations.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in onsite/offshore delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP SD certification preferred.
  • Experience with SAP GTS, CRM, or SAP TM is an added advantage.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Domain experience in manufacturing, retail, FMCG, or automotive industries preferred.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • MBA/PGDM is an added advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and client interaction skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and leadership abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities effectively.
  • Strong documentation and presentation capabilities.

3. Hiring: SAP BASIS Consultant

Job Title: SAP BASIS Consultant

Experience: 10 12 Years

Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid; remote option available with travel as needed

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Position Description

Seeking an experienced SAP BASIS Consultant with 10+ years of expertise in SAP landscape administration, cloud platforms, upgrades, migrations, and AMS support across SAP environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support SAP ECC, BW, EWM, SLT, Solution Manager, Fiori, GRC, and Portal systems.
  • Manage SAP environments on Azure, AWS, and on-premises platforms.
  • Perform system refreshes, kernel upgrades, patching, add-on installations, SSO configuration, and housekeeping activities.
  • Support SAP Solution Manager functions, including System Monitoring, EWA, ChaRM, ITSM, DVM, and Satellite System Configuration.
  • Execute performance tuning, capacity planning, and infrastructure optimization.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA upgrades, conversions, SAP RISE PCE implementations, cloud migrations, and hypercare activities.
  • Manage backup, recovery, HA/DR setup, and disaster recovery drills.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end critical business operations.

Required Skills

  • 10+ years of hands-on SAP BASIS administration experience.
  • Strong experience with SAP NetWeaver, SAP landscape management, and AMS support methodologies.
  • Expertise in:
    • SAP Solution Manager, EWA, ChaRM, and ITSM
    • System Refresh (ABAP and Java)
    • Kernel and Support Package Upgrades
    • Fiori Administration
    • Performance Tuning and Capacity Planning
    • SSO Configuration
  • Experience with Oracle, HANA, MS SQL, and Sybase databases.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle/HANA installation, upgrades, patching, HA/DR, backup, and restore.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA upgrades and conversions.
  • Experience with SAP RISE PCE and cloud migrations (Azure/AWS).
  • Good understanding of Windows, SUSE Linux, RHEL, OEL, and AIX environments.
Preferred Skills

  • SAP BASIS certification.
  • Experience with Azure monitoring, cost optimization, and cloud operations.
  • Exposure to large enterprise SAP landscapes.

Personal Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Flexibility to travel within India and overseas as required.

4. Hiring: Senior SAP BW Consultant / SAP BW Lead

Job Title: Senior SAP BW Consultant / SAP BW Lead

Experience: Minimum 10+ Years of Relevant SAP BW Experience

Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid; remote option available with travel as needed

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP BW Consultant with 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Business Warehouse (BW), SAP BW/4HANA, and SAP Business Intelligence solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in data modeling, data extraction, reporting, analytics, ETL processes, and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end SAP BW solution design, implementation, support, enhancement, and enterprise reporting optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP BW/BW4HANA implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support projects.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP BW functional and technical specifications.
  • Design, develop, and optimize SAP BW data models and reporting solutions.
  • Configure and support SAP BW processes, including:
    • Data Modeling (InfoObjects, ADSOs, Composite Providers)
    • Data Extraction and Transformation
    • DataSources and ETL Processes
    • Process Chains
    • BEx Queries and Reporting
    • BW on HANA/BW/4HANA
    • Performance Tuning and Optimization
    • Data Loading and Reconciliation
    • Open Hub Integration
    • Data Warehousing and Analytics
    • Custom Reporting and Dashboards
  • Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements.
  • Integrate SAP BW with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, SAP BPC, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and non-SAP applications.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration and BW modernization initiatives.
  • Prepare functional and technical specifications for custom developments and coordinate with development teams.
  • Conduct system testing, UAT support, defect resolution, and deployment activities.
  • Provide production support and resolve critical business issues within SLA timelines.
  • Mentor junior consultants and support knowledge transfer activities.
  • Create technical documentation, user manuals, and training materials.
Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 10+ years of strong experience in SAP BW/BW4HANA consulting.
  • Minimum 2 3 end-to-end SAP implementation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Data Warehousing, Data Modeling, and Reporting concepts.
  • Expertise in BW on HANA, BW/4HANA, ETL processes, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience integrating with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, HANA, BPC, and SAC.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise reporting, analytics, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with ABAP debugging and BW data extraction concepts.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in onsite/offshore delivery models.

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP BW or BW/4HANA certification preferred.
  • Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, and SAP HANA Modeling is an added advantage.
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive, retail, consumer goods, life sciences, or utilities industries preferred.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • MBA/PGDM is an added advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and leadership capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure.
  • Client-facing consulting experience preferred.

5. Hiring: Senior SAP MM Consultant / SAP MM Lead

Job Title: Senior SAP MM Consultant / SAP MM Lead

Experience: Minimum 10+ Years of Relevant SAP MM Experience

Location: Dallas, TX

Work Mode: Hybrid; remote option available with travel as needed

Employment Type: Full-Time (FTE)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Consultant with 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Materials Management (MM) and related logistics modules. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in procurement, inventory management, vendor management, invoice verification, and integration with SAP SD, PP, WM/EWM, and FI modules.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end SAP MM solution design, implementation, support, enhancement, and business process optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SAP MM implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support projects.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP MM functional specifications.
  • Configure and customize SAP MM processes, including:
    • Procurement Process
    • Purchase Requisition and Purchase Orders
    • Inventory Management
    • Vendor Evaluation
    • Release Strategy
    • Invoice Verification

Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our objective is to provide clients with a unique business perspective on how to leverage SAP technology to improve their operations. This is rooted in EY's SAP service line capabilities (Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch and SuccessFactors) that are focused on helping clients improve performance and increase productivity.

The opportunity

We are looking for an innovative SAP professional to join our Technical Consulting team, specializing in SAP Manufacturing within the Core Supply Chain capability. In this role, you will collaborate with clients and internal teams, leveraging your expertise in SAP technology to drive improved outcomes and sustainable results.

As a Senior Technology Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You will interact with business stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements, ensuring that newly implemented technology solutions meet their needs. Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will spend your time engaging with clients and internal teams to ensure successful project delivery. You will face challenges that require analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, providing you with opportunities to learn and grow in a dynamic environment. This position may require regular travel to meet with clients, allowing you to build relationships and understand their needs better. Key responsibilities include:

  • Interacting with business stakeholders to evaluate business models and processes.
  • Analyzing newly implemented technology solutions to verify they meet business requirements.
  • Collaborating with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Resource (SMR) for SAP Manufacturing during project implementations. Facilitate design workshops and discussions, gather requirements, and recommend tailored S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Successfully guide the implementation of these solutions within client SAP ecosystems.
  • Demonstrate in-depth functional capabilities of SAP Production Planning (PP) and associated modules, coupled with a strong business acumen.
  • Provide exceptional client service by tracking project milestones, managing risks, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders regarding progress and results.
  • Cultivate and sustain relationships with key client personnel at all levels.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you will need a combination of technical and interpersonal skills. Your ability to build relationships and communicate effectively will be crucial.

In a typical engagement, you will engage with the key stakeholders to assess their business and IT needs in the manufacturing and quality management domains. You will provide guidance on leveraging SAP capabilities to address their pain points and identify gaps beyond standard solutions. You will initiate the requirement gathering, architect solutions, blueprinting, testing, complete the workflow and documentation, as well as the functional design of the solution. You will collaborate with stakeholders and the technical team to translate requirements into effective business solutions, overseeing configurations, customizations, and integrations with SAP and non-SAP systems. The following skills and attributes will make a significant impact:

  • Strong analytical and decision-making abilities.
  • Proficiency in technology business requirements definition and analysis.
  • Experience in system configuration design and technology cost-benefit analysis.
  • Ability to manage client relationships and communicate with impact.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • Typically, no less than 2 - 4 years of related work experience in a functional capacity with exposure to the SAP Production Planning (PP) module.
  • A minimum of 2 years of experience with SAP ERP and/or SAP S/4 HANA systems, specifically within the SAP manufacturing domain.
  • Experience with configuration, master data and end to end understanding of the SAP PP module.
  • Strong technical skills in application functional design.
  • Expertise in technology business requirements definition, analysis, and mapping.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills as well as experience with delivering work products including but not limited to business process design documents and functional specification documents.
  • Ability and comfort level researching client inquiries and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices, and new technologies.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have

  • Prior consulting industry experience or deep functional experience in the manufacturing space.
  • Experience with SAP external integrations to MES, MII, ME, DMC, etc.
  • SAP certifications in SAP Manufacturing, Quality Management (QM) or related modules in the production execution space.
  • Experience with at least one full cycle implementation of SAP PP or QM.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are proactive, innovative, and eager to contribute to team success. Top performers are those who demonstrate strong analytical skills, the ability to communicate effectively, and a passion for technology and its impact on business.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

We work with clients across the utility value chain, helping them navigate complex business and technology transformations from strategy through execution.

As an SAP IS-U FI-CA Senior Consultant, you will deliver hands-on configuration and support for utility receivables, payments, collections, and financial processing in SAP IS-U Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI-CA). You will help ensure accurate processing and reconciliation across the meter-to-cash lifecycle while working closely with business stakeholders, technical teams, and connected workstreams.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will work with clients and internal teams to deliver SAP IS-U FI-CA solutions. You will apply your functional knowledge, analytical skills, and utility industry experience to support accurate receivables processing, efficient payment and collection operations, and successful project delivery. This position may require regular travel to meet client needs. Key responsibilities include:

  • Configuring and supporting FI-CA contract accounts, business-partner relationships, main and subtransactions, account determination, posting controls, and open-item processing.
  • Designing and testing payment processing, payment lots, bank-statement or payment-file interfaces, cash-desk flows, payment allocation, returns, refunds, and reversals, as applicable.
  • Configuring clearing strategies, dunning, collections, installment plans, promise-to-pay, security deposits, write-offs, and other receivables processes.
  • Supporting FI-CA events and BRF+ rules where used for process control, automation, and exception handling.
  • Analyzing FI-CA integration with General Ledger, reconciliation, period-end processing, and impacts to billing, tax, and customer-service transactions.
  • Preparing functional designs, configuration documentation, test cases, process flows, and other project deliverables.
  • Executing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing, regression testing, close-cycle validation, and defect resolution.
  • Working with Billing, Customer Service, Retail Choice, banking partners, collection agencies, and FI/CO teams to resolve end-to-end process and interface defects.
  • Providing production support, root-cause analysis, reconciliation assistance, and functional guidance to business users and technical teams.
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders and project leadership to communicate issues, clarify requirements, and support timely solution decisions.
  • Providing knowledge transfer and functional guidance to client teams and junior project team members.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To thrive in this role, you will need a combination of SAP IS-U FI-CA functional knowledge, utility industry experience, and strong client-service skills. Your ability to analyze complex financial processes, collaborate across teams, and communicate clearly will be important to delivering successful outcomes.

  • Strong functional knowledge of SAP IS-U FI-CA and the broader utility meter-to-cash process.
  • Hands-on knowledge of payment processing, clearing, collections, dunning, open-item management, and FI-CA account determination.
  • Understanding of FI-CA integration with SAP IS-U Billing and FI/CO General Ledger, including reconciliation and period-end considerations.
  • Ability to translate business, regulatory, and operational requirements into practical SAP IS-U FI-CA functional designs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate processing and reconciliation exceptions and identify root causes.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with business, functional, technical, and integration teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain functional requirements and solution decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage assigned deliverables, dependencies, risks, and priorities in a client-service environment.

To qualify for the role, you must have

  • A bachelor's degree.
  • Typically, no less than 3 - 4 years of SAP IS-U or SAP Utilities experience, including hands-on experience with SAP IS-U FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience delivering functional requirements, configuration or solution design, testing, and production support in a utility environment.
  • Hands-on experience with payment processing, clearing, collections, dunning, open-item management, and FI-CA account determination.
  • Understanding of FI-CA integration with SAP IS-U Billing and FI/CO General Ledger, including reconciliation and period-end considerations.
  • Understanding of meter-to-cash processes and the dependencies among FI-CA, Billing, Customer Service, Retail Choice, FI/CO, and connected systems.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications, configuration documentation, test scenarios, process flows, and other project documentation.
  • Experience executing unit and integration testing and supporting user acceptance testing, regression testing, defect resolution, close-cycle validation, cutover, and production stabilization.
  • Experience working with business users, technical teams, and project stakeholders to resolve functional and cross-workstream issues.
  • Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you'll also have

  • Prior consulting experience.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Utilities and high-volume FI-CA processing.
  • Exposure to payment service providers, bank interfaces, collection agencies, or automated reconciliation.
  • Experience with FI-CA events or BRF+ for process control, automation, or exception handling.
  • Experience supporting large-scale meter-to-cash transformations, financial close readiness, or post-go-live production support.

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

descriptionHtml:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced SAP IS-U Billing Senior Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Talent Model. Project Talent Model (PTM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work You'll Do/Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.

  • Provide strategic and in-depth research, analysis, and recommendations related to Customer Service business processes, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Billing processes and transactions, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
  • Act as a liaison between the business area and technical support organizations to ensure business needs are properly documented and translated into technical requirements.
  • Support business process analysis, procedure development, workflow optimization, issue resolution, testing, validation, and implementation of operational improvements.
  • Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.

The Team

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.

Qualifications

 Required

  • 5+ years of SAP IS-U Billing experience
  • Experience in utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
  • Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
  • Excellent Written and Communication Skills
  • Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $115,000 to $155,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Step into a role where you'll help shape the future of finance. As part of our Finance Transformation team, you'll collaborate with CFOs, finance leaders, and executive clients to solve their most complex challenges. Leveraging Deloitte's unmatched resources and deep industry insights, you'll deliver innovative, market-driven solutions that modernize finance functions, elevate performance, and drive meaningful organizational change. Join us to empower clients to become strategic business partners, manage risk, and unlock new levels of financial and operational excellence.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an SAP Treasury Senior Consultant on the Controllership and Treasury Transformation team, you will be responsible for helping clients modernize treasury operations, implement technology solutions, and improve business performance.

  • Support the design and implementation of SAP Cash Management and SAP Treasury Management solutions, including transaction management, hedge management and accounting, and liquidity planning.
  • Drive treasury technology transformation workstreams from strategy through execution, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, training, and deployment support.
  • Advise clients on treasury operations, risk management, and technology practices to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and support business objectives.
  • Build and maintain client relationships through project delivery, working sessions, issue resolution, and ongoing support.
  • Contribute to treasury transformation initiatives, treasury management system evaluations, and practice development efforts, including tools, methods, and go-to-market materials.
  • Perform functional configuration and maintenance activities within package technologies in support of client implementations.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to align with the evolving business objectives of organizations. We collaborate with CFOs, CAOs, controllers, and treasurers to develop an efficient, high-quality, data-driven, and tech-enabled controllership and treasury function. This empowers our clients to deliver greater value to their business partners and investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university
  • 4+ years of experience in consulting, corporate treasury, or bank treasury with treasury technology and treasury management systems, including SAP Treasury
  • 2+ years of SAP Treasury consulting experience, including participation in 3+ full life cycle implementations across software development life cycle phases
  • Hands-on experience in at least 2 SAP Treasury components, including Cash Management, Transaction Manager, In-House Cash, Risk Analyzers, Liquidity Planner, Hedge Management and Accounting, SWIFT integration, Bank Communication Management, or integration with financial accounting
  • Experience in treasury transformation initiatives, vendor selection, or treasury management system implementations, including system requirements, solution design, prototyping, testing, training, support procedures, and implementation activities
  • Ability to travel 40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree or professional certification, including Master of Business Administration (MBA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • 4+ years of experience in corporate treasury or treasury management system vendor environments, including SAP integration with trading platforms, including FXall or 360T, and market data feeds, including Bloomberg or Reuters
  • Experience with cash management, foreign exchange, debt capital markets, and interest rate risk management
  • Experience leading workstreams or mentoring junior professionals on consulting or corporate treasury projects
  • Experience presenting to executive stakeholders and leading client workshops
  • Experience using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Access, and supporting proposals and presentations

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/18/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment and design through build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

  • Lead or support SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) implementations across material, business partner, customer/vendor, finance, and custom master data domains, including embedded and hub deployment models.
  • Configure and enhance MDG capabilities, including data models, Floorplan Manager (FPM), BRFplus, validations, derivations, workflows, duplicate detection, matching and merging, and replication through ALE/IDoc or web services.
  • Collaborate with business data stewards, process owners, and client stakeholders to define data requirements, master data standards, governance rules, ownership models, and data quality controls.
  • Perform data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, migration, and reconciliation activities using SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC/LTMOM, LSMW, SAP Data Services, and other extract, transform, and load tools.
  • Develop specifications, test scripts, cutover plans, and migration runbooks, while supporting testing, deployment, hypercare, issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery coordination.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations to enable an Autonomous Enterprise. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

 Required

  • Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree plus 6+ years of experience in SAP, enterprise data management, ERP, or consulting.
  • 5+ years of SAP consulting or enterprise data management experience, including support for at least 2 full-lifecycle enterprise implementations.
  • 4+ years of hands-on SAP MDG or SAP master data implementation experience, including at least 1 full-lifecycle project.
  • 2+ years of SAP MDG configuration experience in at least 1 domain, including at least 2 capabilities such as data models, FPM, BRFplus, validations, derivations, workflow, or replication.
  • 2+ years of experience modeling, mapping, configuring, validating, or maintaining SAP data models and master data structures across at least 2 domains such as material master, business partner, customer/vendor, finance master data, or custom objects.
  • On at least 1 SAP implementation, gathered, documented, and validated data requirements with business stakeholders and executed data migration using SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC/LTMOM, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or an equivalent ETL tool.
  • Ability to travel 50% on average, based on the work performed and the clients and industries or sectors served.

Preferred

  • Master's degree.
  • 2+ years of professional-services delivery experience supporting large-enterprise transformation engagements.
  • SAP MDG on SAP S/4HANA experience across at least 2 implementations, including both embedded and hub deployment models.
  • SAP MDG configuration experience across at least 2 domains and at least 3 capabilities, such as data models, FPM, BRFplus , validations, derivations, workflow, or replication.
  • Experience using at least 2 data migration, data quality, or MDM tools, such as SAP Migration Cockpit, LTMC/LTMOM, LSMW, SAP Information Steward, SAP Data Services, or an equivalent platform.
  • Experience designing or supporting SAP master data integrations using at least 2 technologies, such as ALE/IDoc, APIs, web services, or SAP BTP integration services.
  • Experience on at least 1 project implementing data governance practices, SAP cloud capabilities, or AI-enabled data management solutions, including data profiling, rule mining, cleansing, documentation, testing, or governance reporting.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $1 10 , 7 00 to $2 18 , 3 00.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our goal is to give clients a unique business perspective on how SAP technology can enhance their operations. By leveraging EY’s expertise in SAP, Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer Solutions, Technology & Architecture, and SuccessFactors, we assist clients in enhancing performance and increasing productivity.

The opportunity

We are seeking an SAP IBP professional to join our Technology Consulting team and contribute to complex supply chain transformation engagements. In this role, you will work closely with clients and cross-functional teams to design and implement SAP-enabled planning solutions that improve business performance. You will gain exposure to end-to-end delivery, strengthen your functional and technical expertise, and grow your ability to translate business needs into scalable solutions.

As a Senior in Technology Business Analysis, you will be instrumental in connecting business needs with technical solutions. You will play a pivotal role in evaluating business models, eliciting requirements, and ensuring the technical teams deliver solutions that are in perfect harmony with business objectives.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for delivering top-notch business analysis and system configuration. Your day-to-day will involve:

  • Design, configure, test, and deploy SAP IBP Response & Supply and PP/DS (PPDS) solutions, including time-series and order-based planning capabilities.
  • Translating complex business requirements into detailed technical specifications
  • Configuring and implementing solutions that align with business needs
  • Identifying opportunities for service expansion and contributing to sales through RFP responses
  • Expect to travel regularly and lead project streams while actively engaging with clients.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate SAP IBP and PP/DS with S/4HANA, ECC, and legacy APO environments.
  • Provide design insights and lead the build, testing, and deployment of supply chain solutions across various technology landscapes
  • Exhibit hands-on technical capabilities in SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) tool and demonstrated strong business acumen of demand planning or supply planning capabilities. Show a continuous willingness to learn and adapt to new knowledge.
  • Facilitate client workshops, requirements sessions, and design discussions to help drive solution alignment and adoption.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality client services.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, such as change management, and provide relevant inputs as part of larger transformation engagements.
  • Show curiosity and initiative in developing client sector knowledge to help co-create EY industry solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

On your typical engagement, you will collaborate with EY workstream leads, assisting them during the exploration and design phases to capture business requirements and propose technology designs. Following the design phase, you will lead in the build, testing and deployment phases with minimal oversight. You will be expected to engage in horizontal collaboration with cross-functional teams and will also have the opportunity to coach and develop teams vertically.

To thrive in this role, you should be action-oriented and adept at delivering processes, solutions, and projects. Your influence will extend beyond project delivery, impacting sales and service offerings. Key skills include:

  • Analytical prowess and decision-making based on a broad understanding of policies.
  • Ability to execute SAP IBP and PP/DS solution activities across design, build, test, and deployment phases, supporting alignment with demand, supply, production, and S&OP planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SAP IBP Response & Supply and PP/DS, including planning heuristics, scheduling strategies, optimizer functionality, and order-based planning processes.
  • Strong capability to translate supply chain requirements into scalable SAP IBP solutions using standard functionality and leading practices.
  • Experience contributing to solution design discussions with cross-functional stakeholders (planning, finance, operations) and validating business requirements.
  • Solid functional knowledge of demand and/or supply planning, including planning KPIs, data models, and integration touchpoints.
  • Understanding of integration between SAP IBP, PP/DS, S/4HANA, ECC, and legacy APO environments.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with global delivery teams to support configuration, testing, and defect resolution.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, accountability, and ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

To qualify for the role, you must have:

  • A bachelor’s degree.
  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and/or SAP Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS) experience, including configuration experience in one or more areas such as Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP, Inventory Optimization, or Response & Supply, Production Planning, or Detailed Scheduling.
  • Experience supporting at least one end-to-end IBP or PP/DS implementation, transformation or major enhancement cycle.
  • Strong understanding of supply chain planning processes, including forecasting, supply planning, inventory, and S&OP.
  • Experience translating business requirements into functional designs and working closely with technical teams to deliver SAP IBP and PP/DS solutions.
  • Functional knowledge of SAP IBP Response & Supply and/or PP/DS, including planning heuristics, scheduling concepts, capacity planning, and optimizer capabilities.
  • Strong client communication skills with experience facilitating design or testing sessions.
  • Proven ability to manage deliverables independently and contribute to workstream execution.
  • A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have:

  • Prior consulting experience in supply chain planning transformations.
  • SAP certifications in relevant areas such as IBP for Supply Chain (e.g., Response & Supply), S/4HANA Production Planning (PP) and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS), or Integrated Business Planning for Demand and Supply.
  • Experience with integrations to SAP S/4HANA (e.g., CIF, SDI, RTI) and data modeling concepts in IBP.
  • Experience with planning analytics, dashboards, and scenario modeling in IBP.

What We Look For

We seek individuals who demonstrate leadership, the ability to work independently, and a passion for making an impact. Top performers in our team are those who show a relentless drive for excellence, a collaborative spirit, and the ability to navigate complex challenges with innovative solutions.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $122,900 to $204,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $128,100 to $213,400
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $102,500 to $187,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.
  • At EY, our values set the foundation for how we work and the behaviors we expect of our people. Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities including veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and either need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during any part of the application process, please call 1-800-EY-HELP3, select Option 2 for candidate related inquiries, then select Option 1 for candidate queries and finally select Option 2 for candidates with an inquiry which will route you to EY’s Talent Shared Services Team (TSS) or email the TSS at ssc.customersupport@ey.com.

- Experience with SAP IS-U customer, business partner, contract account, utility contract, premise, service connection, and customer-service processes.

Job Description

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

 SAP S/4 HANA SD Functional Consultant with minimum 10+ years of experience of implementing SAP S4, preferably for a USA based manufacturing company

 Proficiency in SAP’s standard implementation framework and hands-on experience in designing and implementation of complex and heterogeneous landscape (SAP and non-SAP)

 Experience in conducting workshops with business users for process analysis, design and configuration needs pertaining to SD functionalities

 SAP product knowledge in specific process areas such as:

  • Production Execution
  • Sales Order Processing
  • Customer Master setup
  • Account Determination
  • Delivery Processing (shipping, shipment). Integration to EWM / TM preferred
  • Customer Invoicing including revenue recognition
  • Integration knowledge between Sales and other functional areas with specific reference to production and material movement / logistics

 Hands-on experience in data cleansing and conversion related activities

 Cut-Over activities identification and execution along with Go-live and Post Go-Live Support Experience of Integration with Planning system of SAP/non-SAP

Roles & Responsibilities

 Requirements Analysis: Gathering site-specific “AS-IS” processes and mapping them to “To-Be” standard SAP workflows

 Functional Testing: Conducting unit/integration testing and coordinating user acceptance testing with site business process owners to validate configurations

 User Training: Delivering hands-on training sessions and creating localized SOPs and manuals for site staff

 Data Migration Support: Assisting with the final validation of cleansed site data before it is loaded into live system

 Order to Cash (O2C) localization: Mapping the site’s unique sales processes into standard S/4HANA sales document types

 USA Tax Integration: Configuring the connection between SAP and external tax engines to ensure accurate Sales & Use Tax calculation for different US jurisdictions

 Complex Pricing Logic: Designing and testing pricing procedures that account for bulk discounts, freight surcharges, and regional price lists specific to building materials

 Shipping & Transportation Integration: Coordinating with the site’s logistics team to manage delivery scheduling, picking lists, and integration with Transportation Management (TM) or external carriers

 Credit & Risk Management: Implementing credit limit checks and block/release workflows to manage financial risk for large-scale construction accounts

 Direct support for site staff: Providing support to customer service reps and shipping clerks to troubleshoot real-world order issues during first weeks of operation

Generic Managerial Skills, If any

 Excellent Communication

 Team Management Skills

 Managing Support L2/L3

Salary Range : $130,000 to $160,000 Per Annum

TCS Employee Benefits Summary

Discretionary Annual Incentive.

Comprehensive Medical Coverage: Medical & Health, Dental & Vision, Disability Planning & Insurance, Pet Insurance Plans.

Family Support: Maternal & Parental Leaves.

Insurance Options: Auto & Home Insurance, Identity Theft Protection.

Convenience & Professional Growth: Commuter Benefits & Certification & Training Reimbursement.

Time Off: Vacation, Time Off, Sick Leave & Holidays.

Legal & Financial Assistance: Legal Assistance, 401K Plan, Performance Bonus, College Fund, Student Loan Refinancing.

Qualifications: BACHELOR OF COMPUTER SCIENCE

Your collaboration with technical teams will be essential in designing and delivering effective system architecture solutions.

  • Experience in system configuration design and technology cost-benefit analysis.
  • Ability to manage client relationships and communicate with impact.

  • Strong technical skills in application functional design.
  • Expertise in technology business requirements definition, analysis, and mapping.

  • Prior consulting industry experience or deep functional experience in the manufacturing space.
  • Experience with SAP external integrations to MES, MII, ME, DMC, etc.
  • SAP certifications in SAP Manufacturing, Quality Management (QM) or related modules in the production execution space.
  • Experience with at least one full cycle implementation of SAP PP or QM.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
